designs.title: No.
designs.why: Smart, wearable idea: the cat lying on the word and pawing the full stop is classic cat behaviour, and the deadpan half-lidded face lands the 'No.' attitude. The silhouette reads from 3 m on both tees, and the one-ink linework is confident with clean weights. Holding it back: the uniform white dashes in the letters look clip-art, and the stripes on the tail and letters don't match the plain white body, so the striping looks applied rather than part of the cat. The joke also stops short, because the dot sits safely on the baseline with rule running on past it.
designs.fix: Push the gag: end the bottom rule right at the dot so it sits on the very edge, mid-push, about to drop. That makes the cat knocking the full stop off the shelf the punchline. Loosen the letter striping into irregular, brushy tabby marks.
